prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right choice depends on what you need (hospital vs. private practice vs. med device), your budget, scope (brand vs. lead generation vs. physician recruitment), and preferred working style. I can recommend options, but first a couple quick clarifying questions so I can give a tailored answer:

- What type of client are you (hospital system, clinic, private practice, med device/pharma, health tech startup)?  
- What are the main goals (brand awareness, patient acquisition, digital ads/SEO, content/PR, recruitment, product launch)?  
- Rough budget or monthly retainer range?  
- Timeline and whether you need one-off services or an ongoing partner?

If you want to evaluate agencies yourself, here are the most important criteria and questions to use:

Key criteria
- Proven healthcare experience (HIPAA/regulatory understanding).  
- Case studies and measurable results (CPL, conversion rate, ROI).  
- Relevant services (SEO, paid search/social, content, PR, physician outreach, analytics).  
- Size and capacity to handle your scope.  
- Cultural fit and communication process.  
- Integration ability with clinical/EMR systems and compliance teams.  
- References from similar clients.

Questions to ask agencies
- Can you show healthcare-specific case studies and outcomes?  
- How do you handle HIPAA and patient-data privacy?  
- What KPIs will you track and how often will you report?  
- Who will be the day-to-day contact and what does the team look like?  
- What’s your onboarding process and timeline to first results?  
- Can you provide references for similar clients?

If you’d like, I can:
- Pull a shortlist of 3–5 St. Louis agencies with strong healthcare experience and summarize their strengths, pricing signals, and sample work; or  
- Recommend agencies matched to your specific needs if you answer the questions above.

Which would you prefer?
